edges.reason: Constructor derives owner, king and queen directly from msg.sender without any authorization check.
msg.sender is assigned to the privileged owner state variable in the constructor.

require(msg.sender == owner) gates blueprint registration.
Building struct is written into the buildings mapping.
buildings_total is incremented for each registered blueprint.
buildings_total is used as the write index into the buildings mapping.
msg.sender indexes the kingdoms mapping in every user-facing function.
logResources reads resources of the caller kingdom.
Resources event data is read from kingdoms[msg.sender].resources.
Caller factors determine whether the caller becomes king or queen.
kingSpirit is overwritten with the caller resourceFactors[10].
king is set to msg.sender when the spirit check passes.
queenPrestige is overwritten with the caller resourceFactors[11].
queen is set to msg.sender when the prestige check passes.
initiateUser checks and sets kingdoms[msg.sender].initiatet.
totalCities is incremented on each first-time initiation.
buildAt operates entirely on the caller kingdom.
building parameter drives resource, factor and map writes in buildAt.
building parameter indexes the buildings blueprint mapping.
xpos selects the map cell written by buildAt.
ypos selects the map cell written by buildAt.
buildAt performs unchecked resource subtraction and factor/population addition.
resource and resourceFactors balances of the caller kingdom are mutated.
buildAt invokes newLeader to re-evaluate throne holders.
expandX reads the caller kingdom mapY for the price assertion.
expandX performs an external value transfer to owner.
mapX state update is executed after the external transfer call.
expandY reads the caller kingdom mapX for the price assertion.
expandY performs an external value transfer to owner.
mapY state update is executed after the external transfer call.
block.timestamp enforces the claim cooldown via assert(now >= lastClaimResources + 1 hours).

Caller resource balances and lastClaimResources are updated.
now is used both for the cooldown assertion and as randomness entropy.
shopIndex selects the resource factor, cooldown slot and item tier.
claimSpecialResource performs modulo arithmetic to derive the awarded item.
block.timestamp is the sole entropy source for the pseudo-random selection.
Awarded items are added to the caller resource balances.
sellItem lists items held by the caller kingdom.
item parameter selects the resource slot and marketplace entry.
price parameter is stored as the listing price.
marketplacePrices[msg.sender][item] is set to price.
marketplaceID[msg.sender][item] is set to the current sell_id.
sell_id is incremented after each listing.
buyItem credits the caller kingdom and pays the caller-controlled seller.
seller parameter indexes marketplacePrices and marketplaceID.
item parameter selects the purchased resource slot.
buyItem performs four external value transfers derived from msg.value.
marketplacePrices[seller][item] is reset to zero after the external transfers.
Caller resource credit happens before the external transfers complete.
buySpecialBuilding modifies the caller kingdom map and factors.
xpos parameter selects the map cell to write.
ypos parameter selects the map cell to write.
building parameter selects the 97/98/99 tier and its factor boost.
buySpecialBuilding forwards msg.value to owner via an external transfer.
newLeader writes throne state after the external transfer has been made.
buySpecialBuilding calls newLeader to re-evaluate throne holders.
claimSpecialResource credits items to the caller kingdom.
